description: How many liters you need: 10 to 25 L for day hikes, 30 to 50 L for overnights, 50 to 80 L for longer trips, plus how to estimate gear volume.
directAnswer: Plan 10 to 25 liters for day hikes, about 30 to 50 for overnights with compact gear, 50 to 65 for three to five nights and 65 to 80 for long or winter trips. Pick the smallest pack that fits.
